### Description

Provide a clear and concise description of the feature or improvement.

### Problem

Describe the problem, limitation, or use case this feature addresses.

### Proposed Solution

Describe the expected behavior and how the feature should work.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Feature behavior is implemented as described.
- [ ] Expected user flows work correctly.
- [ ] Edge cases and error states are handled appropriately.
- [ ] Existing functionality remains unaffected.

### Additional Context

Include relevant screenshots, references, dependencies, technical considerations, or related issues.
